{"FINDINGS": [{"id": "F1", "title": "Potential Time-of-Check Time-of-Use vulnerability in token validation", "detail": "The is_valid function performs signature verification before checking expiration. If an attacker can manipulate the 'now' parameter or the system time, they could potentially exploit this order of operations to bypass expiration checks. The function uses a time-based comparison (now - issued_at <= SESSION_TTL_SECONDS) which could be manipulated if the system clock is adjusted or if the 'now' parameter is controlled.", "severity": "medium", "location": "auth/tokens.py:17"}], "NOT_REACHED": []}
